idea.title: SignalScout — Real-time trend scanner for indie hackers

plan.tagline: Scans for real-time trends to help indie hackers make informed decisions
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small businesses lack the resources to monitor market trends effectively
plan.solution: SignalScout scans online data, identifies trends, generates reports, and sends alerts to help users stay informed and make data-driven decisions
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide
plan.demo_script: Runs a simulated trend scan, generates a report, and sends a notification using hardcoded data
plan.phuket_angle: Helping Phuket tourism businesses identify trends in traveler preferences to inform their marketing strategies
